name: Bierfassl
kurzbeschreibung: A pint of beer in Neustift im Stubaital Traditional Tyrolean beer culture in the heart of the Alps In the picturesque village of Neustift im Stubaital, just a stone’s throw from…
beschreibung: The Bierfassl in Neustift im Stubaital is a stylish bar with an inviting atmosphere and an exquisite drinks menu. Whether classic cocktails, fine wines, or regional beers - every guest finds the right drink for a perfect evening. The interior blends modern design with cozy elements, creating a feel-good atmosphere to linger in. The experienced bartenders are also happy to craft creative signature drinks unique to this venue. Whether an after-work get-together, a relaxed evening with friends, or the start of a long night out - Bierfassl offers the ideal setting for sociable hours in Neustift im Stubaital.
